title: Admin Stats Endpoint — Total Scans Today
last_note: Implemented GET /admin/scan/stats in new AdminScanController (@PreAuthorize("hasRole('ADMIN')")), backed by new DiscoveryAdminRoleAuthenticationFilter/DiscoveryAuthenticationEntryPoint/DiscoveryAccessDeniedHandler/SecurityConfig (EnableMethodSecurity, filter-chain permitAll) mirroring admin-service's T056 shape but swapping the path-matcher authorization rule for method security. Added ScanSessionRepository.countScansStartedToday (JPQL, UTC day boundary computed in new ScanStatsServiceImpl) and spring-boot-starter-security to discovery-service's pom.xml. On admin-service: new DiscoveryServiceClient/Impl (WebClient + CircuitBreaker, no fallback, same convention as UserServiceClient.getStats() T105), DiscoveryServiceProperties, discoveryServiceWebClient bean in WebClientConfig, and discoveryService circuit breaker instance + discovery-service.base-url in application.yml. No dotnet/mvn/codegen CLI commands required — no schema migration, reuses existing scan_sessions.started_at column.
